kind: local execution plus recorded replay and mocked failures
paid_test_limitation: The only bounded live dispatcher uses the Neri security-research pilot ledger. This development evaluation did not repurpose it. The other live context-screening caller lacks a cumulative spend cap and has no default HTTP timeout.

claim_evidence.baseline: Independent read-only agent checks requirements, source, tests and receipt before correcting handoff.
claim_evidence.tested: Three initial claims: one partly supported, one contradicted, one not demonstrated; payment holdout inspected after initial pass.
claim_evidence.jev_judgment: Not executed. Two historical claim-related Jev answers are retained without original state/questions, so accuracy cannot be independently graded.
claim_evidence.downstream: Agent corrected all three distinctions; no required check was disabled. The six replayed read-only answers match registered core anchors. A corrected frozen-source audit confirmed one imprecise citation in draft A; several other exact source snapshots were unavailable for line validation.
claim_evidence.input_weakness: The current raw request can accept selective state and unverifiable source/rubric hashes; dry run demonstrated this.
claim_evidence.integration: A reference assembler tied to task/run/revision IDs and fixed rubric would be required; ordinary independent verification remains authoritative.

skill_discovery.baseline: Current filesystem skill descriptions plus st skills status; 83 healthy links/copies and zero drift, with dirty canonical source.
skill_discovery.tested: Real codebase-design selection and use on the Jev transport/ledger seam; no-fit and inadequate-shortlist fixtures; bitmap skill held out.
skill_discovery.jev_judgment: Not executed. Two historical skill-choice answers lack recoverable original packets.
skill_discovery.downstream: The worker used codebase-design and identified the existing two-caller seam; no new abstraction was needed.
skill_discovery.input_weakness: Eligibility exclusions and candidate coverage must be verified from live skill text; a bad shortlist can force a false choice.
skill_discovery.integration: Would need a versioned capability snapshot and explicit none-fits option; current skill status and descriptions already work.

search_reranking.baseline: Current st search Precision Code Search ranking and its symbol/text fallback.
search_reranking.tested: Three live read-only searches with retrieved passages and one absent-answer probe; historical docs and truncated source slice were retained.
search_reranking.jev_judgment: Not executed. One historical development-search answer has no recoverable original passages.
search_reranking.downstream: The agent found ProjectSelector by reading the first current-code result and one file, with zero irrelevant files read; no reorder was needed.
search_reranking.input_weakness: The missing-symbol query still retrieves a self-referential historical doc; mixed query source slice is explicitly truncated. Reranking cannot supply absent source evidence.
search_reranking.integration: Requires passage-level results, source revision and authority metadata and answer-absent handling; current ranking is already useful on these cases.

repeated_issues.baseline: Agent Hub feedback duplicate candidates use exact title or PostgreSQL full-text search, same component/type and open status.
repeated_issues.tested: Real heartbeat feedback plus paraphrase and different-context fixtures; real failed step-999 task and paused duplicate-session task used in downstream handoff.
repeated_issues.jev_judgment: Not executed; no matching historical Jev replay with full concern and attempt history.
repeated_issues.downstream: Read-only worker linked relevant history, preserved both concerns, and warned against repeating an unverified skip-step-999 patch. It did not equate heartbeat polling with duplicate sessions.
repeated_issues.input_weakness: Error text alone merges unrelated providers/revisions; stale task descriptions contain unverified root-cause hypotheses.
repeated_issues.integration: A semantic candidate suggestion would need original concern, status, environment/revision and prior attempts; never auto-merge or suppress.

workflow_variant.baseline: Existing source-frozen native context-delivery comparison: scoped versus Security Research active, three tasks per variant.
workflow_variant.tested: Replay of six actual native executions plus independent blind review of paired outputs against pinned source; fixed prompt-history case inspected separately.
workflow_variant.jev_judgment: Not executed on the variant outputs; prior 13/13 synthetic context-pair screening is a different task.
workflow_variant.downstream: Independent verifier accepted all six core answers; no A/B acceptance decision changed. The corrected frozen-source review confirmed one draft-A line citation to source_snapshot instead of source_revision; several other exact source snapshots were unavailable.

frozen_source_citation_audit.confirmed_imprecise: draft A: context_policy.py:110 cites source_snapshot; source_revision is at 127-128 in recorded hash 5f574359e61e4869eea72243fa47208203a0a3ea4bbbc335c8e09826782820cd

workflow_variant.input_weakness: A final-answer-only packet omits commands, tests and delivery evidence. The reviewer brief mistakenly supplied today's Agent Hub revision rather than the native receipt's source hashes, producing false alarms. Some frozen hashes are not reconstructable from available commits, limiting line checks.
workflow_variant.integration: Requires immutable prompt/delivery revisions, equivalent full execution evidence for both variants and a fixed external rubric; no production prompt change justified.

model_effort_routing.baseline: Native role assignment and explicit model/effort selection; current catalog plus exposed spawn schema.
model_effort_routing.tested: Deterministic receipt count, actual tool-capable read-only scouts requested on gpt-6-luna/low, missing-context and consequential-review fixtures, historical Jev routing labels inspected.
model_effort_routing.jev_judgment: Not executed for a new task. Historical routing answers have no original task packets or linked worker runs.
model_effort_routing.downstream: Two scouts completed useful source discovery with full task context; receipt count was solved by jq with no model. No Jev-selected profile was executed.
model_effort_routing.input_weakness: Agent Hub catalog lists codex/gpt-5.6-luna, which this native spawn schema does not expose, and omits native exposed gpt-6-luna; missing task context must be retrieved before routing. Jev itself lacks chat/tools.
model_effort_routing.integration: Needs verified live profile eligibility, tool/context/privacy/effort checks, full task handoff and usage receipts before comparing against current roles.

best_next_action: Do not add Jev to development workflow decisions on this evidence.
